legend: Trotles is given a set of n$$$n$$$ nodes and wants to construct a functional graph where the in-degree and out-degree of each node is 1$$$1$$$. Luckily for him, he is already given the some of the edges. For the rest of the edges he randomly chooses a node with the out-degree 0$$$0$$$ and a node with in-degree 0$$$0$$$ (they can be the same node) and draw an edge from the first one to the second one. Calculate the expected number of cycles in the graph modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.
input: The first line contain n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$, the number of nodes and the number of given edges respectively. 1≤m≤n≤105$$$1 \le m \le n \le 10^5$$$
The next m$$$m$$$ lines contain two numbers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ which means that there is an edge drawn between nodes a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$. 1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \le a, b \le n$$$
It is guaranteed that the in-degree and out-degree of each node given in the test case will be less than or equal to 1$$$1$$$.
output: Print a single integer representing the expected number of cycles.
If the number of cycles is pq$$$\frac{p}{q}$$$ then print p⋅q−1(mod109+7)$$$p \cdot q^{-1} \pmod {10^9 + 7}$$$.

legend.ai: Trotles 得到了一组包含 n$$$n$$$ 个节点的集合，并希望构造一个函数图，使每个节点的入度和出度均为 1$$$1$$$。幸运的是，他已经得到了一些边。对于其余的边，他会随机选择一个出度为 0$$$0$$$ 的节点和一个入度为 0$$$0$$$ 的节点(它们可以是同一个节点)，并从前者向后者连一条边。计算图中环数量的期望值，并对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模。

input.ai: 第一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$，分别表示节点数和给定边的数量。1≤m≤n≤105$$$1 \le m \le n \le 10^5$$$
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行包含两个数 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$，表示节点 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$ 之间有一条边。1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \le a, b \le n$$$
保证测试用例中给出的每个节点的入度和出度都小于等于 1$$$1$$$。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示环数量的期望值。
如果环的数量是 pq$$$\frac{p}{q}$$$，那么输出 p⋅q−1(mod109+7)$$$p \cdot q^{-1} \pmod {10^9 + 7}$$$。
